in_marathi.name: Gurkamal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurkamal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gurkamal is derived from Sanskrit words ‘guru’ (teacher, guide) and ‘kamal’ (lotus). This name signifies that the person is the jewel or precious possession of their guru or teacher. In Hindu mythology, the lotus symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and detachment. Therefore, Gurkamal can be considered a name for a boy who embodies these qualities, having been guided by a wise and enlightened teacher.
